column1: # Stage S4 B1a — tools/verification_core splits into the tools/foundation crates verification_core,
# process_runner and repository_laws, and process_runner takes xtask's host bridge and ssh transport.
# Paths name the tree before the moves.
# the verdict, pattern, scan, gate, lock and report modules stay one crate, now under tools/foundation
# the child-process module becomes the process_runner crate: its vocabulary becomes run.rs
# xtask's container-to-host bridge and ssh transport are process mechanics and join process_runner
# the repository laws become the repository_laws crate: the module root becomes the crate root
# the moved laws name their own items from the crate root, and the verdict, scan and pattern
